Clarence Thomas.reasoning: The text of 2 U.S.C. § 7 and 3 U.S.C. § 1 plainly establish a single federal Election Day, and the original public meaning of Article I, § 4 and Article II, § 1, cl. 4 confirms that Congress possesses plenary authority to fix uniform times for federal elections precisely to prevent the manipulation and faction the Framers feared from staggered or extended voting periods.
